text_blocks.snippet: A COVID-19 antibody test is a blood test that determines if a person has developed antibodies against the virus that causes COVID-19. These antibodies are proteins produced by the body in response to the virus. The test helps to identify if someone has had a past infection, even if they were asymptomatic.
